notes.title: Gameplay Demonstration 01
notes.content: I will display a recording of gameplay from the game.

notes.title: Demo coming soon!
notes.content:
Very soon I will be releasing a demo version of Dental Strike. You will be able to play the first world out of five in the game. This way, you can play 6 complete stages.

It would be of great help if you could provide your feedback and, especially, report any bugs you encounter!

I'm looking forward to you having fun playing! :)

[i]Adauto Lino - Joycat Games[/i]
